items.text: Giants GM Joe Schoen told reporters that RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. is being placed on injured reserve due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury; must miss minimum 4 games per IR rules
items.implication: NYG lead RB out; backfield volume opens for remaining RBs and new additions
items.opportunity: Potential lead back role for Greg Desrosiers or other Giants RBs

items.text: The #Bengals have placed TE Erick All Jr. on Injured Reserve with what is believed to be a torn ACL, source say. The team signed TE Cam Grandy off the #Vikings practice squad.
items.implication: CIN TE room thinned further; Gesicki and others elevated
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Bengals TEs
